name: Default
shortDescription: Web UI for torrent clients, deployed with a bundled Transmission daemon and a shared persistent downloads volume.

alerts.message: The first account you register becomes the admin, so register right after deployment. On that form pick Transmission, URL http://flood-transmission:9091/transmission/rpc, username flood and the generated TRANSMISSION_PASS from the environment settings.
The BitTorrent peer port is not published, so Transmission can only reach peers through outgoing connections.
